elements.label: filter envelope amount, minus 96 to plus 96 semitones

designNotes.purpose: Deep four-operator FM sound design through a direct, compact workflow. Core working controls remain exposed; occasional construction tools expand horizontally.
designNotes.envelopes: One explicitly selected oscillator envelope, with three ghost curves, on a locked nonlinear time scale. Attack 0 ms–20 s; decay/release 1 ms–60 s; sustain −infinity–0 dB. Initial/peak and curvature are graph edits. Filter has one independent envelope in the same editor.
designNotes.looping: Attack/decay loop in free, beat-fit or note-pitch-fit modes. Synced loops preserve proportions/curves. Note-off immediately enters normal release from current level. Boundary reset versus continuous restart is undecided.
designNotes.host: 200 px height; left rail: power, device menu, bottom-up name, macros, modulators. Both panels open independently. Uniform square slots at two/three/four-high sizes, with additional columns after four. Full-unit presets include macros, mappings and nested chain.
designNotes.prototype: Buttons demonstrate named states; numeric inputs retain session text. Curve/partial edits are illustrative immediate preview states, not a native sound engine or freehand editor. Undo for real synthesis edits remains a native interaction requirement.
designNotes.reviewRefinements: Loop regions/readouts follow the selected A/D durations. Synced A/D fields show proportions, with cycle/rate captions and a shared 2 s note-off preview. Active curves render above ghosts. Default panels are closed; three slot content sizes, routing paths/feedback target, slider fills, glide and keyboard focus have explicit visual treatments. Filter levels use 0–100% and bipolar depth uses −96 to +96 semitones. Loop restart behavior remains open.
designNotes.sectionSelection: Click an oscillator section background to select its envelope. The colored left rectangle only enables/disables that oscillator. Filter section background selects its independent envelope; cutoff/resonance edits preserve selection. Section selection uses a blue outline/fill and keyboard focus, not duplicate letter/env buttons. Routing diagram itself opens a visual preset palette; there is no separate label or text selector.
designNotes.envelopeReadouts: Point names have a reserved 96 px header region, separate from the exact-value field. The selected section supplies oscillator/filter context; initial, peak, decay/sustain, release and curvature readouts cannot overlap their names.
designNotes.loopClarity: The first A/D cycle retains its stronger tint. A faint held-region tint and repeat bracket extend exactly to the shared note-off marker. Note-off and release are separately labelled; no inter-cycle reset/continuation connector is drawn while that behavior remains undecided. All modes retain the shared nonlinear time scale.
designNotes.filterEnvelope: A bipolar envelope amount is always visible: -96 to +96 semitones, default 0 st, fine adjustment. Filter envelope levels are normalized 0–100%; the cutoff offset in semitones is amount × envelope level. Positive depth raises cutoff, negative lowers it. Clamp the resulting frequency to the supported filter cutoff range. The example shape has 0% initial/end, 100% peak and 50% sustain. Positive/negative depth previews use a 500 Hz base and +/-24 st. Native DSP and continuous editing remain unimplemented in this concept.
